CHAPTER 3 · ITEM 05 / 08

Gains and terms of trade

Terms of trade貿易條件

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Find a mutually beneficial range for the price of a good in terms of the other good: it must lie strictly between the two producers' opportunity costs for both to gain from that exchange.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

雙方嚴格得益的價格須介乎兩者機會成本，單位必須一致。在端點時，其中一方只是無差異。

For both to gain strictly, the exchange price of a good must lie between their opportunity costs, expressed in the same units. At an endpoint, one party is indifferent in the simple constant-cost model.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：X costs its exporter 1 Y and importer 2 Y. Trading 1 X for 1.5 Y benefits both. 出口者收多於成本，進口者付少於自製代價。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Costs of 1 X are 2 Y and 5 Y. Which price gives strict gains to both? 哪個價格互利？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
